component.name: Selucid
component.summary: SELinux AVC denial visualizer and troubleshooter

description.p: Selucid is an open-source, system-level visualizer and troubleshooting toolkit for RHEL, Fedora, and compatible distributions. It bridges the gap between cryptic SELinux AVC denials and the humans who must fix them.

Selucid reads audit log denials, explains them in plain language, cross-checks against the loaded policy via audit2why, and guides the user through narrow, non-destructive fixes — restorecon, setsebool, semanage, or audit2allow module generation — via Polkit authorization.
The GTK4/Libadwaita desktop app presents a live denials list, a detail pane with diagnosis and suggested fixes, a searchable booleans explorer, and live tailing of the audit log.

ul.li: GTK4/Libadwaita desktop app: denials list, detail pane, booleans tab, live tailing, theme toggle, preferences window.
CLI: explain, suggest, watch, why, export, fix, booleans, simulate, inspect, report, history, rollback, audit.
TUI: full-screen terminal interface with Vim keys, incidents/history tabs.
Core: nom parser, grouping, inference, oracle cross-check, privileged pkexec runner, sandbox simulator, anomaly detection, compliance audit.
